workerCapacity.coordination: Cross-process dispatch.lock is held from admission counting through queued-state persistence and worker PID commit.
workerCapacity.fullBehavior: A new job returns worker-capacity before writing its job JSON or spawning a process. Existing job IDs return their current state before the capacity check. Malformed job records conservatively consume a slot.

engineTimeout.cleanup: Process polling uses try_wait; timeout terminates and reaps the process. Windows children are assigned to a kill-on-close Job Object. Listing output is drained by a bounded reader thread while the parent polls process exit and deadline.

installerRollback.preflight: Validates explicit extension/helper/engine inputs, owned manifest and config structure, and refuses a foreign native host registration before replacing files.
installerRollback.transaction: Backs up manifest, config, and the prior registry default-value snapshot; stages writes; commits HKCU registration last; restores prior registry value and files on failure.
installerRollback.incompleteRollback: Keeps the backup directory and reports its exact path.

errorCodesForParentMapping.worker-capacity: Keep the existing job pending and poll/reissue start with the same job ID; the rejected ID has no persisted job JSON yet.
errorCodesForParentMapping.queue-timeout: Generic failed extraction state; do not map to wrong-password.
errorCodesForParentMapping.engine-timeout: Generic failed extraction state; do not map to wrong-password.
